brief:
The Arab Ministers Council of Health granted imprisoned Palestinian physician Hisam Abu Safiya the 2026 "Medicine of Resilience" award, recognizing his steadfast medical work at Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza during the ongoing war despite blockade and attacks, Shehab Wire reported.

Abu Safiya has remained in Israeli detention since December 2024. The council honored his continued commitment to his medical mission at the hospital throughout the conflict.
